notes: Accurate, well-scoped advice with verifiable operator actions.

defects.quote: neither the reference ... nor evaluation ... window had a business or resource policy defined
defects.why: NO_POLICY does not prove that no policy was configured; it establishes only that no applicable rule produced a policy result.

defects.quote: No business or resource policy thresholds were defined
defects.why: The evidence and NO_POLICY verdict do not establish that policy thresholds were not configured.

defects.quote: inspect the lag profile beyond lag 0
defects.why: The evidence reports only a lag-0 profile entry, so it provides no lag profile beyond 0 to inspect.
NO_POLICY does not establish the absence of configured thresholds or policies.

notes: It preserves most key facts but repeatedly misstates what NO_POLICY establishes.

defects.quote: p95 latency difference between the windows (evaluation 193 ms vs reference 211 ms)
defects.why: 193 ms and 211 ms are the evaluation and reference p50 values, not p95 values.

notes: Otherwise accurate and actionable, but it directs investigation using incorrectly labelled latency percentiles.
Accurate, cautious analysis that keeps correlation and policy conclusions appropriately bounded.
